## TLDR

<!-- One or two sentences: the problem and resulting behavior. -->

## Problem

<!-- Concrete trigger and current behavior. Link the existing issue using
Closes #, Fixes #, or Relates to #. Only typo-only docs edits, CI/dependency
chores, release chores, or maintainer-approved emergency fixes may omit an
issue; explain the exception here. -->

## Consequences

<!-- Why this matters to users or maintainers. -->

## Example

<!-- A short, concrete before/after scenario. Code is optional. -->

## Solution

<!-- How the final change solves the problem, in plain English. -->

## Gain

<!-- The resulting benefit. Link evidence for quantified claims. -->

## Tradeoffs

<!-- Relevant costs, limitations, breaking changes, or remaining risks. -->

## Validation

<!-- List exact commands and key results. Explain relevant checks not run.
Docs-only changes may mark Rust checks not applicable. Storage/recovery and
performance claims need raw evidence and applicable acceptance-gate results;
passing unit tests alone does not qualify those claims. -->
